                                   Resolution 2022-29
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

                   RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
   FOR THE REHABILITATION OF THE PEDESTRIAN SAFETY CORRIDOR
                   ALONG ARLBERG AVE

WHEREAS, Girdwood Valley Service Area Manager requested improvements to the structure and resurfacing
of the bike path along Arlberg Avenue between Alyeska Highway and Alyeska Resort Hotel; and

WHEREAS, the bike path is a major corridor for safe pedestrian travel to work at Alyeska Resort and recreate
from the ski area and trails beyond; and

WHEREAS, the current road maintenance contractor is an efficient and reasonable company who will be able
to do the work necessary to improve this pedestrian safety corridor, and

WHEREAS, the projected cost for this project is $900,000, application is for $800,000 with 11% match from
the Girdwood Valley Service Area Roads 406 account; and

WHEREAS, this action has been discussed and considered by the Girdwood Trails Committee, which voted
unanimously in favor of recommending this resolution at their December 7, 2022 regular meeting.

THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the rehabilitation and repaving of the Pedestrian
Safety Corridor along Arlberg Ave and supports an application for a Transportation Alternative Program grant
to achieve this goal.

PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 19th day of December 2022.





Briana Sullivan                                            Attest
GBOS Parks and Recreation and Cemetery Chair
